info.title: Atlas API
info.description: Atlas backend API. Authentication uses a server-side session stored in an HttpOnly cookie named atlas_session. JWT is not used, and session ids are not returned in response bodies.

get.description: Creates a one-time OAuth state and redirects the browser to the DingTalk authorization page.

post.description: Accepts a temporary DingTalk H5 logon-free authCode from the frontend, exchanges it server-side for the real DingTalk contact userid, maps or creates the Atlas user, syncs DingTalk organization profile fields, creates a server-side session, and sets atlas_session as an HttpOnly cookie. This flow does not use OAuth state or a callback redirect.

200.description: DingTalk H5 identity verified and mapped to an Atlas user. A session cookie is set.

get.description: Validates OAuth state, exchanges the DingTalk authorization code, fetches DingTalk personal information, resolves the real DingTalk contact userid for users.dingtalk_user_id, syncs user_profiles from whitelisted DingTalk fields, writes a sanitized audit event for successful profile syncs, creates a server-side session, and sets atlas_session as an HttpOnly cookie. Organization-detail profile sync failures do not block login. The response body does not include the session id.

200.description: DingTalk identity verified and mapped to an Atlas user. A session cookie is set.

302.description: Browser redirect to configured frontend callback URL when the request prefers HTML.

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly atlas_session cookie on successful login.

get.description: Reads the atlas_session HttpOnly cookie and returns the current Atlas user.

Requires only an authenticated session; every user may read their own permissions. Evaluates every catalog permission for the current user and returns the granted ones as concrete object:action strings, with wildcards, role inheritance, and layer precedence already resolved. Intended for frontend menu and button gating; the backend still enforces permissions on every request.

200.description: Effective permissions of the current user.

post.description: Revokes the current server-side session and clears the atlas_session cookie.

get.description: Requires permission users:read. Lists Atlas users. User records are created only by the DingTalk external login flow; this API only reads existing users.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return users with this status.

get.description: Requires permission users:read. Returns one Atlas user by the internal user id.
Returns one user's DingTalk-synced profile. Users may read their own profile without users:read; reading another user's profile requires users:read.

post.description: Manually fetches the user's DingTalk organization details and upserts user_profiles. Users may sync their own profile without users:write; syncing another user's profile requires users:write. The API uses users.dingtalk_user_id as the real DingTalk contact userid, writes a sanitized user_profiles audit event on success, and does not store DingTalk userid, tokens, secrets, session ids, raw profile data, or personal information plaintext in the audit payload.

Requires permission users:write. Updates only the Atlas user status. dingtalk_user_id cannot be changed through the user management API. Setting target_status to disabled revokes the user's active sessions; setting it to active does not create a session.

Requires permission users:write. Hard deletes one Atlas user record by internal user id. The user's auth_sessions records are deleted first to satisfy current foreign key constraints. User records are still created only by DingTalk external login; after deletion, the same dingtalk_user_id can be recreated by a future DingTalk login.

204.description: User record and the user's auth sessions were deleted.

get.description: Requires permission products:categories:read. Lists product categories with optional status and operation-count filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return product categories with this status.

parameters.name: requires_operation_count_filter
parameters.description: Only return categories that match whether operation counts are required.

get.description: Requires permission products:categories:read. Returns one product category by id.

post.description: Requires permission products:categories:write. Creates a product category. category_name must be unique.
Requires permission products:categories:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; required fields cannot be set to null.
Requires permission products:categories:write. Sets product category status to disabled and keeps the category record. Existing products may continue to reference it.
Requires permission products:categories:write. Hard deletes one product category record by id. Returns 409 if products still reference the category.

get.description: Requires permission products:read. Lists sales-content master records with optional status, category, keyword filtering and pagination. Products are the selectable sales/service content, not sales record types.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return products with this status.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only return products in this product category.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Trimmed keyword matched against name, series, brand_name, specification and unit. Blank values are ignored.

get.description: Requires permission products:read. Returns one product by id.

post.description: Requires permission products:write. Creates a product. category_id must reference an active product category. unit_price is a decimal string and is stored as DECIMAL(12,2).

Requires permission products:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; nullable text fields can be cleared with null; category_id cannot be null and must reference an active product category.
Requires permission products:write. Sets product status to disabled and keeps the product record.
Requires permission products:write. Hard deletes one product record by id only when it has no business references. Products referenced by sales_record_lines.product_id must be disabled instead.

get.description: Requires permission events:read. Lists audit/approval events with optional filters and pagination, newest first.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Only return events for this resource type (table name).

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Only return events pointing at this resource row.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Event type: 0 create, 1 update, 2 delete, 3 approve, 4 reject, 5 custom.

parameters.name: approval_status
parameters.description: Approval status: 0 none (review events and audit-only records), 1 pending, 2 approved, 3 rejected.

parameters.name: custom_type
parameters.description: Only return custom events (event_type 5) whose caller-defined kind equals this value.

parameters.name: target_event_id
parameters.description: Only return approve/reject events targeting this event.

get.description: Requires permission events:read. Returns one audit/approval event by id.

post.description: Records an approve event targeting the given pending create/update/delete event. The reviewer must hold the object:action permission declared statically for the target's resource type (each reviewable type declares its approval permission in code at registration, e.g. products:approve); there is no static route permission. Once distinct approvers reach required_approval_count, the stored change is applied to the business table in the same transaction and the target becomes approved (2). Each user may review a given event only once. Returns the refreshed target event.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Id of the event to approve.

200.description: Review recorded; the refreshed target event is returned.

409.description: The event is no longer pending (event_not_pending) or this user already reviewed it (duplicate_review).

422.description: The target is itself an approve/reject event (event_not_reviewable) or its resource type is not registered (unknown_resource_type).

post.description: Records a reject event targeting the given pending create/update/delete event. A single reject vetoes the target: it immediately becomes rejected (3) and is never applied. Permission rules match the approve endpoint. Returns the refreshed target event.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Id of the event to reject.

200.description: Review recorded; the refreshed target event is returned.

409.description: The event is no longer pending (event_not_pending) or this user already reviewed it (duplicate_review).

422.description: The target is itself an approve/reject event (event_not_reviewable).

get.description: Requires permission departments:read. Lists departments with optional status, source and parent filtering plus pagination. Departments are read-only over HTTP except for DingTalk sync; rows are created by sync or internal tooling.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return departments with this status.

parameters.name: source_filter
parameters.description: Only return departments from this source.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Only return direct children of this department id.

get.description: Requires permission departments:read. Returns one department by id.

post.description: Requires permission departments:write. Fetches the DingTalk organization tree and upserts rows with source dingtalk: new departments are inserted, renamed or re-parented departments are updated, deletion is not synced and manual rows are never touched. Returns a summary of the sync.

get.description: Requires permission systems:read. Lists systems with optional status filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return systems with this status.

get.description: Requires permission systems:read. Returns one system by id.

post.description: Requires permission systems:write. Creates a system.
Requires permission systems:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; null is rejected for required fields.
Requires permission systems:write. Sets system status to disabled and keeps the system record.
Requires permission systems:write. Hard deletes one system record by id. Returns 409 if the system still has stores.

get.description: Requires permission stores:read. Lists stores with optional status and system filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return stores with this status.

parameters.name: system_id
parameters.description: Only return stores owned by this system id.

get.description: Requires permission stores:read. Returns one store by id.

post.description: Requires permission stores:write. Creates a store and requires system_id to reference an existing system.
Requires permission stores:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; null is rejected for required fields.
Requires permission stores:write. Sets store status to disabled and keeps the store record.
Requires permission stores:write. Hard deletes one store record by id.

get.description: Requires permission customers:read. Lists customers with optional status, scope, creator and name keyword filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return customers with this status.

parameters.name: system_id
parameters.description: Only return customers owned by this system id.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Only return customers owned by this store id.

parameters.name: creator_user_id
parameters.description: Only return customers created by this user id.

get.description: Requires permission customers:read. Returns one customer by id.

post.description: Requires permission customers:write. Creates a customer. creator_user_id is always taken from the authenticated session. Only name and store_id are required; system_id is derived from the store and checked for consistency when provided.

Requires permission customers:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; null is rejected for required fields; remark and attachments can be cleared with null. creator_user_id cannot be updated.
Requires permission customers:write. Sets customer status to disabled and keeps the customer record.
Requires permission customers:write. Hard deletes one customer record by id. Business delete should normally use disable.

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read.

200.description: All roles ordered by priority, then code.

post.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. The role kind is immutable after creation. When priority is omitted, kind defaults apply: position=20, department=30, custom=40 (smaller wins; 0 is reserved for user-level policies).

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read.

200.description: Role detail including direct parent role ids.

patch.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. kind cannot be changed. The builtin super_admin role is protected; attempts to update it are rejected with error code protected_system_role.

delete.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Also removes the role's policies, inheritance links, and user assignments. The builtin super_admin role is protected; attempts to delete it are rejected with error code protected_system_role.

put.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Replaces the full parent set. The child role inherits every policy of its parents (e.g. sub-department inherits parent department). Cycles and inheritance chains deeper than 8 links are rejected. The builtin super_admin role is protected; attempts to edit its parents are rejected with error code protected_system_role.

get.summary: List users assigned to a role
get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read. Member records are slim (id and status only): user-domain fields such as dingtalk_user_id require users:read via the users endpoints.

put.summary: Add a user to a role
put.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Atomic single-membership write: unlike PUT /permissions/users/{userId}/roles it cannot clobber concurrent edits to the user's other roles. Idempotent — adding an existing member succeeds without change.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a role
delete.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Atomic single-membership write; idempotent for non-members. Removing a holder of the protected builtin super_admin role is rejected with error code protected_system_role.

204.description: Membership removed (or user was not a member).

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read.

200.description: Roles directly assigned to the user.

put.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Replaces the full role set of the user. If the user currently has the protected builtin super_admin role, the replacement must preserve it; attempts to remove it are rejected with error code protected_system_role.

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read.

200.description: Policies matching the optional subject filter.

post.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Objects are colon-separated scopes (e.g. finance:invoices). In policy objects, a trailing * matches all remaining segments and * matches one segment. The object/action must cover at least one permission from the catalog (see /api/v1/permissions/catalog); otherwise the request is rejected with error code permission_not_in_catalog. Effect resolution: user policies override role policies; roles with smaller priority override larger; within the same priority, deny overrides allow. The builtin super_admin role and its policies are protected; attempts to add policies directly to it are rejected with error code protected_system_role.

201.description: Policy created and enforced on subsequent requests.

delete.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Policies belonging to the protected builtin super_admin role cannot be deleted and are rejected with error code protected_system_role.

204.description: Policy deleted and no longer enforced.

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read. Returns every permission the backend enforces: builtin route permissions plus approval permissions of registered review resource types. Policy writes are validated against this catalog, so it is the authoritative list for the permission panel's selection matrix.

200.description: All enforceable permissions with grouping metadata.

put.summary: Replace all policies of a subject
put.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Replaces the full policy set of one user or role in a single transaction followed by exactly one policy reload; this is the bulk save behind the permission panel's edit-matrix flow. An empty policies array clears every policy of the subject. Each object must cover at least one catalog permission (exactly or via wildcards) and (object, action) pairs must not repeat; any validation failure rejects the whole request and leaves the existing policy set untouched. The builtin super_admin role and its wildcard policy are protected; attempts to replace that role's policies are rejected with error code protected_system_role.

200.description: New policy set of the subject, enforced on subsequent requests.

get.description: Requires permission sales:records:read. Lists sales or service facts. Sales records are the receivable/source facts; payments are the performance source.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return records with this status.

parameters.name: record_type
parameters.description: sale is a closed sale; service is service/pre-sale groundwork with zero receivable and no payment.

get.description: Requires permission sales:records:read. Returns one sales or service fact with lines, payments and payment allocations.

post.description: Requires permission sales:records:write. Creates one sale fact, one or more product lines, and one initial payment in a single transaction. The customer determines system_id and store_id; product category determines whether a line needs operation counts.
Requires permission sales:records:write. Creates a service/pre-sale groundwork fact. Lines must have receivable_amount 0.00. No payment, debt or performance is created.
Requires permission sales:records:write. Voids a sales record and its lines, payments and operation-count accounts. Active operation usages must be voided or deleted first.

get.description: Requires permission sales:records:read. Lists initial payments and collection payments. Payments are the source of performance.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return payments with this status.

parameters.name: payment_type
parameters.description: initial is the sale-time payment; collection is later debt collection.

get.description: Requires permission sales:records:read. Returns one payment with guide allocations.

post.description: Requires permission sales:records:write. Adds a collection payment to an existing active sale record. The payment cannot exceed the dynamic outstanding amount.
Requires permission sales:records:write. Voids one payment; outstanding amount is recalculated from active payments.

get.description: Requires permission sales:operation-counts:read. Operation-count accounts are attached to sales_record_lines.id.
Requires permission sales:operation-counts:read. Uses sales_record_line_id as the account id.

post.description: Requires permission sales:operation-counts:write. total_count cannot be lower than used_count.

get.description: Requires permission sales:operation-usages:read. Operation usages consume operation counts on a sales record line.
Requires permission sales:operation-usages:read.

post.description: Requires permission sales:operation-usages:write. Creates an operation usage and increments used_count on the sales record line account.
Requires permission sales:operation-usages:write. Adjusts used_count when operation_count changes.
Requires permission sales:operation-usages:write. Voids an active usage and decrements used_count.
Requires permission sales:operation-usages:write. Hard deletes a usage and decrements used_count if it was active.

get.description: Requires permission products:read. Returns distinct non-empty series, brand_name and unit values for product form suggestions. Supports the same status/category/keyword filters as product listing.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only use products with this status.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only use products in this product category.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Trimmed keyword matched against name, series, brand_name, specification and unit. Blank values are ignored.

parameters.name: limit_per_field
parameters.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return for each field.

AtlasSessionCookie.name: atlas_session
AtlasSessionCookie.description: Server-side session cookie. It is set as HttpOnly by the backend and is not returned as a JSON field.

authCode.description: Temporary DingTalk H5 logon-free authorization code obtained by the frontend in the DingTalk container.

dingtalk_user_id.description: Real DingTalk contact userid used for external login mapping. This is not unionId, openId, or uuid.

user_id.description: Atlas internal user id. This is also user_profiles.user_id.

mobile.description: Personal information. Logs must not output this field in plaintext.

email.description: Personal information. Logs must not output this field in plaintext.

org_email.description: Personal information. Logs must not output this field in plaintext.

department_external_ids.description: JSON string containing DingTalk dept_id_list. DingTalk userid is not stored here.

kind.description: Immutable after creation. Determines the default priority layer.

priority.description: Smaller values take precedence. Defaults by kind: position=20, department=30, custom=40.

parent_role_ids.description: Direct parent roles whose policies this role inherits.

RoleMemberResponse.description: Slim member record. User-domain fields (dingtalk_user_id, timestamps) are deliberately excluded: they require users:read, while this schema is served under system:permissions:read.

subject_id.description: users.id when subject_kind=user, roles.id when subject_kind=role.

object.description: Colon-separated scope path, e.g. finance:invoices. May contain * segments; a trailing * matches all remaining segments.

permissions.description: Concrete object:action permission strings the current user holds, e.g. products:read. Wildcards, role inheritance, and layer precedence are already resolved.

object.description: Colon-separated scope path this entry describes, e.g. products:categories.

actions.description: Actions the backend enforces on this object.

group.description: Display group for the permission panel, e.g. 商品.

object.description: Colon-separated scope path. May contain * segments; a trailing * matches all remaining segments. Must cover at least one catalog permission.

policies.description: The subject's new full policy set. (object, action) pairs must not repeat. An empty array clears every policy of the subject.

unit_price.description: Decimal price string stored as DECIMAL(12,2), for example 12.30.

ProductResponse.description: Sales-content master record. This represents selectable content such as products, medical items, instrument items and cards; sale/service is represented by sales_records.record_type, not by product category.

unit_price.description: Decimal price string stored as DECIMAL(12,2).

CreateProductRequest.description: Creates a sales-content master record. category_id must reference an active product category.

unit_price.description: Decimal price string stored as DECIMAL(12,2).

UpdateProductRequest.description: Partially updates a sales-content master record.

name.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because name is required.

status.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because status is required.

system_id.description: Must reference an existing system id from systems.id.

name.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because name is required.

system_id.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because system_id is required. The value must reference an existing system.

status.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because status is required.

file_id.description: External file or object-storage identifier for the image.

mime_type.description: When present, must be an image MIME type.

creator_user_id.description: User who created this customer. This value is derived from the authenticated session on create and cannot be set by clients.

attachments.description: External image attachment metadata. Empty when the customer has no attachments.

system_id.description: Optional compatibility field. On create, the backend derives the system from store_id; when provided, this value must match the store's system.

store_id.description: Required existing store id. The backend derives system_id from this store.

attachments.description: Optional external image attachment metadata. Omit or pass an empty array when the customer has no attachments. The backend stores this as JSON text and does not upload or store image bytes.

name.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because name is required.

system_id.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because system_id is required. If changed, the final system/store scope must stay consistent.

store_id.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because store_id is required. If changed, the final system/store scope must stay consistent.

remark.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null clears the customer remark.

attachments.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null clears attachments.

status.description: Omit to leave unchanged. null is rejected because status is required.

receivable_amount.description: Decimal amount string returned with exactly two decimal places.

paid_amount.description: Decimal amount string returned with exactly two decimal places.

outstanding_amount.description: Decimal amount string returned with exactly two decimal places.

target_status.description: Target Atlas user status. disabled revokes active sessions; active does not create sessions.

UpdateProductCategoryRequest.description: Partial update request. Omitted fields are unchanged; null is rejected for required fields.

resource_type.description: Name of the business table this event targets.

resource_id.description: Id of the targeted row. Null for create events until they are approved and applied, at which point it is backfilled with the new row id.

actor_user_id.description: User who created this event (submitter for create/update/delete, reviewer for approve/reject).

event_type.description: 0 create, 1 update, 2 delete, 3 approve, 4 reject, 5 custom (caller-defined audit event named by custom_type).

approval_status.description: 0 none (the event needs no review: an approve/reject review event, an audit-only record, or a custom event), 1 pending, 2 approved, 3 rejected.

required_approval_count.description: Distinct approvers needed before the change is applied. Null for approve/reject events.

custom_type.description: Caller-defined kind name for custom events (event_type 5), e.g. login or export. Null for all other event types.

target_event_id.description: For approve/reject events, the event being reviewed. Null otherwise.

old_value.description: JSON snapshot of the row before the change. Null for create and approve/reject events.

new_value.description: JSON payload of the row after the change. Null for delete and approve/reject events.

remark.description: Reviewer comment; only present on approve/reject events.

updated_at.description: When the event was finalized (approved/rejected). Null while pending and always null for approve/reject events.

remark.description: Optional review comment stored on the approve/reject event.

source.description: Where this department row comes from: DingTalk sync or manual creation.

external_department_id.description: External department identifier. For dingtalk rows this is the DingTalk dept_id as a string.

parent_id.description: Parent department id from departments.id. Null for top-level departments.

receivable_amount.description: Decimal amount string returned with exactly two decimal places.

paid_amount.description: Decimal amount string returned with exactly two decimal places.

allocated_amount.description: Decimal amount string returned with exactly two decimal places.

lines.description: For service records, every line receivable_amount must be 0.00 and operation_total_count is not allowed.

product_id.description: Must reference an active product/sales-content master record.

receivable_amount.description: Decimal amount string stored as DECIMAL(12,2).

operation_total_count.description: Required for sale lines whose product category requires operation counts. Not allowed for service records.

paid_amount.description: Initial payment amount. Must be greater than 0.00 and cannot exceed sale receivable amount.

allocation_ratio.description: Allocation ratio. Ratios within one payment must total 100.00.

sales_record_id.description: Must reference an active sale record.

paid_amount.description: Collection amount. Must be greater than 0.00 and cannot exceed outstanding amount.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked session.

Forbidden.description: The mapped user exists but is disabled.

PermissionDenied.description: The authenticated user lacks the required permission (error code permission_denied), or the user is disabled.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing data, such as a duplicate role/policy or a system that still has stores.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Validation failed: invalid kind/effect/action, empty segments, inheritance cycle, chain too deep, or protected system role mutation (error code protected_system_role).
